task_name: Add scheduler, admin trigger, status and overlap prevention

concerns_addressed: Overlap prevention shared via DataPipelineService::hasActiveRun across scheduler and HTTP trigger with explicit conflict response.
Manual trigger after failure creates a new run UUID and returns 202 accepted; no automatic retry behavior.
02:00 Asia/Jakarta schedule registered with dailyAt, timezone, and withoutOverlapping; prior-day and 30-day window verified frozen at 2026-09-14 02:00.
Admin-only status/manual-trigger endpoints preserve 401/403 authorization contract; legacy AI routes unchanged.

strengths: Exact schedule string registration and thin command/controller adapters over the guarded service.
Single named overlap guard reused across all trigger paths.
Fresh UUID per run with no retry loop.

issues.description: DataPipelineService is ~320 lines, near the ~300-line heuristic; no new function exceeds thresholds and no 3x duplication introduced.
